# Australian & New Zealand Mental Health Association

> ANZMH is a non-profit mental health association advancing the field through professional development, conferences, and community advocacy across Australia and New Zealand.

The organization serves mental health professionals, frontline workers, and the broader community through membership programs, specialized conferences, and evidence-based resources. ANZMH hosts multiple annual conferences addressing diverse areas including addiction, neurodivergence, indigenous wellbeing, rural mental health, and child/adolescent mental health.

## Key Topics

- mental health professionals
- professional development

## Conferences & Events

- [2026 International Mental Health Conference](https://anzmh.asn.au/imhc): IMHC26 international conference on Gold Coast for mental health professionals
- [2027 Child & Adolescent Mental Health Conference](https://anzmh.asn.au/camhc): CAMH27 in Brisbane for child and adolescent mental health professionals
- [2026 Neurodivergence Wellbeing Conference](https://anzmh.asn.au/nwc): NWC26 conference on Gold Coast for neurodivergence wellbeing and inclusion
- [2026 Rural Mental Health Conference](https://anzmh.asn.au/rmhc): RMHC26 on Gold Coast addressing rural mental health and suicide prevention
- [AddictionZ 2026](https://anzmh.asn.au/addictionz): AddictionZ 2026 conference on Gold Coast for addiction and mental health professionals
- [2026 Indigenous Wellbeing Conference](https://anzmh.asn.au/iwc): Indigenous Wellbeing Conference 2026 in Canberra on indigenous leadership

## Organization & Membership

- [About Us](https://anzmh.asn.au/about-us): Mission, history, and organizational overview of ANZMHA since 1999
- [Become a Member](https://anzmh.asn.au/membership): Membership benefits, professional discounts, and educational opportunities
- [Advisory Committee](https://anzmh.asn.au/advisory-committee): Board members and governance structure of ANZMHA leadership
- [Ambassadors](https://anzmh.asn.au/ambassadors): Mental health ambassadors including Libby Trickett advocating for stigma reduction
- [Partnerships](https://anzmh.asn.au/partnerships): Corporate partnership and sponsorship opportunities with ANZMHA

## Resources & Support

- [Mental Health Resources for Frontline Workers](https://anzmh.asn.au/mental-health-resources-for-frontline-workers): Support resources for frontline workers addressing PTSD, burnout, and resilience
